originalTitle: Ethiopia and Eritrea cut diplomatic ties as northern conflict escalates
title: A Puzzle in Africa: Ethiopia and Eritrea Aren't Chatting Right Now
content:
Hello, my wonderful friends! Your kid-friendly news reporter from Africa is here to share some important news. Sometimes, countries, just like people, have big disagreements. Today, we're going to talk about two very important countries in Africa: Ethiopia and Eritrea. They are neighbors, which means they live right next to each other, just like you might live next to your best friend.

What's Happening in Ethiopia?

Right now, there's a bit of a puzzle in Ethiopia. In a part of Ethiopia, way up north, there's a big problem. The country's army, who are like super-important protectors for everyone, is having a serious disagreement with a group of people called 'rebel fighters'. These rebel fighters are people who feel very strongly that things in Ethiopia should be different, and they are trying to make changes. When grown-ups can't agree, sometimes they start to fight, and that's what's happening there. Fighting is never a good thing, is it? It makes people sad, and it can make it hard for everyone to go to school, play, and just live their normal lives. Imagine if you and your friends couldn't agree on which game to play, and instead of talking, you started pushing! It wouldn't be fun at all. That's a little bit like what's happening, but much bigger, with armies and many people involved. The grown-ups in charge are trying to figure out how to stop the fighting and make sure everyone is safe. The fighting has been going on for a little while, and it's making many people worried. When there's fighting, houses can get hurt, and sometimes people have to leave their homes to be safe. It’s a very serious situation, and many kind people all over the world are hoping that the fighting will stop soon so that everyone in Ethiopia can live in peace. **Did you know?** Ethiopia is a very old country, with a history going back thousands of years! It's also famous for being where coffee was first discovered. So, every time you see a grown-up drinking coffee, you can remember Ethiopia!

Why Aren't They Talking?

Because of this fighting in Ethiopia, something else has happened. Ethiopia and its neighbor, Eritrea, have decided to 'cut diplomatic ties'. Wow, that's a big, fancy phrase, isn't it? Let's break it down. 'Diplomatic ties' is a special way of saying that countries usually have special people called ambassadors, who are like messengers. These messengers talk to each other to help their countries work together, share ideas, and solve problems without fighting. They help countries be friends, or at least be good neighbors. When countries 'cut diplomatic ties', it means they have decided to stop talking to each other through these messengers. It's like if you and your friend had a big fight, and you both decided not to talk or play together anymore. When countries stop talking, it makes it much harder to fix problems, because talking is often the very first step to finding a solution. It's a bit like trying to solve a puzzle with one of your best helpers suddenly not there to give you clues. Imagine if your family had a problem, and everyone just stopped talking to each other. It would be very hard to find a way to make things better, wouldn't it? That's why grown-ups usually try very hard to keep talking, even when things are difficult. For Ethiopia and Eritrea, this decision means they are not working together as closely as they used to. This makes it harder for them to share important information or help each other with things like trade or keeping their borders safe. **Did you know?** Eritrea has a beautiful coastline along the Red Sea. This means it has amazing beaches and lots of interesting sea creatures! It's a wonderful place to visit and enjoy nature.

Why Is This Important?

When two important countries in Africa, like Ethiopia and Eritrea, aren't talking, it can make things a bit tricky for other countries too. Just like when two friends fight, it can make other friends feel sad or worried. When countries don't talk, it's harder to share things that can help everyone, like ideas about how to grow more food or how to keep people healthy. It can also make people in both countries feel uncertain about the future. This situation is making many people across Africa and around the world hope very much for peace. Everyone wants the fighting to stop in Ethiopia, and for Ethiopia and Eritrea to start talking to each other again. Talking is always the best way to solve problems, even very big ones. It helps everyone understand each other better and find solutions that work for everyone. When countries are friends and work together, everyone benefits! This news also reminds us that even grown-ups can have big problems, and it takes a lot of effort and kindness to solve them. We all wish for a time when these two neighboring countries can be good friends again, helping each other and living in peace. **Did you know?** The African continent is home to many different languages – over 2,000 of them! People in Africa are very good at communicating in many ways, which helps them connect with each other.

Wishing for Peace

So, my young friends, while there's a puzzle right now, we always hope for peace. We hope that the grown-ups will find a way for the fighting to stop in Ethiopia and for the leaders of Ethiopia and Eritrea to start chatting again very soon. Africa is a continent full of joy, music, beautiful animals, and incredible people. When countries work together, Africa shines even brighter! Let's all send our good wishes for peace and friendship to Ethiopia and Eritrea. Remember, even though this news sounds serious, many, many people are working hard to make things better. And talking, even when it's hard, is always the best way forward. Stay curious and keep learning!
summary: Two countries, Ethiopia and Eritrea, are not talking to each other right now because there is some fighting in a part of Ethiopia, and everyone hopes they can be friends and talk again soon.
whyMatters: This is important because when countries stop talking, it makes it much harder to fix problems and help each other, and everyone wishes for peace and friendship to return.

originalTitle: Trump ramps up pressure on US Republicans to end US clock switching
title: No More Clock Changes? A Big Idea in America!
content:
Hello, Amazing Kids of Africa!

Hello, hello, my wonderful friends! Welcome to Kids News Africa! I'm your super reporter, and today we have a really interesting story to share with you. It's all about time, the sun, and a big idea from a faraway place called America! Have you ever wondered about time? We all use clocks and watches to tell time, right? We know when it's morning for school, afternoon for playing, and evening for dinner and sleep. Time helps us know what to do and when to do it! It's super important!

What is Time, Really?

Time is like a long, long river that never stops flowing. It helps us measure how long things take. One minute, one hour, one day, one week! Our Earth spins around and around, and that's how we get day and night. When your part of Earth faces the sun, it's daytime! When it faces away, it's nighttime. So cool! Did you know? The sun always rises in the east and sets in the west! It's like a giant clock for our planet!

The Sun and Our Day

The sun gives us light and warmth. We love sunny days for playing outside, don't we? But sometimes, during different parts of the year, the sun can feel a little different. In some places, like America, the mornings can be very dark, even when it's time to wake up. And other times, the sun stays out very late! This is because of how our Earth moves around the sun. It's like a giant dance! Because of this dance, some places have longer daylight in summer and shorter daylight in winter.

Changing Clocks: What's That?

Now, here's where it gets interesting! In some countries, like America, people do something called 'changing clocks'. Can you imagine? It means they move their clocks forward or backward by one whole hour! It's like magic, but not really! They usually do this twice a year. Once in the spring, and once in the autumn. It can be a little confusing! Imagine waking up and finding your clock is suddenly an hour ahead or behind! Did you know? Many countries in Africa, like Kenya and South Africa, do NOT change their clocks! They keep their time the same all year round! Hooray for no confusion!

Daylight Saving Time (DST)

Let's talk about the 'Daylight Saving Time' part. This is when people move their clocks *forward* by one hour. This usually happens when spring begins. Why do they do it? So they can have more sunshine in the evening! Imagine this: If the sun usually sets at 6 o'clock, when they move the clocks forward, it will now feel like it sets at 7 o'clock! That's an extra hour of daylight for playing outside after school, or for grown-ups to do things in the garden. It sounds like fun, right? More time to play in the sun!

Going Back to Standard Time

But then, when autumn comes, they have to change the clocks *back* again! This is called 'Standard Time'. They move the clocks *backward* by one hour. This makes the mornings a little brighter, but the evenings get darker earlier. So, less playtime in the evening light. It's like a big clock dance that happens every year! Forward in spring, backward in autumn.

Why Do People Change Clocks?

So, why did people start doing this clock-changing thing? A long, long time ago, people thought it would help save energy. If there's more daylight in the evening, people might not need to turn on their lights so early. Less electricity used means saving energy! They also thought it would be good for farming and for people to have more time to enjoy the outdoors. It was a good idea back then!

But Wait, Some Don't Like It!

Even though it sounded like a good idea, changing the clocks can be tricky! Some people don't like it at all. Why? * **Sleep Problems:** When the clocks change, your body might get confused. It feels like you've lost an hour of sleep or gained an hour. This can make you feel tired or grumpy for a few days! * **Confusion:** It's easy to forget if you need to move the clock forward or backward. You might miss school or be late for something important! * **Safety:** Some grown-ups worry about children waiting for the school bus in the dark mornings, or people driving home when it's suddenly dark earlier. Did you know? Changing clocks can make some people feel a little out of sorts for a whole week!

A Big Idea in America: Stop Changing Clocks!

Because of all these reasons, some leaders in America have a big idea! They want to stop changing the clocks forever! They want to choose one time and stick with it all year long. No more moving clocks forward and backward! This means they would pick 'Daylight Saving Time' to be the time they use all the time. So, lots of sunshine in the evenings, all year round! More time for playing outside after school, even in winter!

What Does 'Permanent' Mean?

The word they use is 'permanent'. 'Permanent' means it will stay the same forever and ever! No more spring forward, no more autumn back. Just one time, all the time. Can you imagine? So, if this idea comes true, children in America would always have extra daylight in the evening. This could mean more time to play football, ride bicycles, or just run around in the park before dinner! It sounds like a lot of fun for kids, doesn't it?

More Play Time, But Darker Mornings?

Having more daylight in the evening is awesome for playing! But if they make Daylight Saving Time permanent, it could also mean that mornings would be darker for longer during some parts of the year. Some children might have to go to school when it's still dark outside! This is something they are talking about. It's a big decision with good things and tricky things. But it's exciting to think about keeping time simple!

Our News Wrap-Up!

Wow, what a journey through time and clock changes! It's amazing how much thought goes into something we use every single day. We hope you learned something new about time and how some places want to make it simpler. We'll keep an eye on this story and let you know what happens! Thank you for joining me on Kids News Africa! See you next time, and keep exploring the amazing world around you!
summary: Some leaders in America are talking about a big idea to stop changing clocks twice a year and keep the time with more sunshine in the evening all the time, making it 'permanent' so kids can have more time to play outside.
whyMatters: This matters because if they stop changing clocks, it means people will always have the same time, which could be less confusing and give more evening play time, even though some mornings might be darker.

originalTitle: 'I want to discover Manchester' - Olid hunts recommendations
title: A Football Manager's New Adventure!
content:
Meet Eva Olid!

Hello, amazing kids! Imagine you have a very important job, like leading a super cool football team. That's exactly what our friend Eva Olid does! She is a football manager for a big team called Manchester United. Have you ever watched a football game? It's a sport where two teams try to kick a ball into the other team's net. Eva helps her team play their very best. Manchester United is one of the most famous football teams in the whole world! They play in red shirts and have many wonderful players. Eva is in charge of helping these players learn and grow. She plans how they will play their games and makes sure everyone is happy and working together. It’s a very big job, just like a captain of a ship or a teacher in a classroom!

What Does a Manager Do?

So, what does a football manager like Eva do every day? Well, she doesn't kick the ball herself during the game, but she makes all the important decisions! She decides which players will play in each game. She helps them practice new moves and strategies. A manager is like the coach and the leader all rolled into one. She makes sure everyone understands the game plan. Think about it like this: if you have a favourite game you play with your friends, a manager would be the person who helps everyone play fair and have fun, and also helps your team win! Eva works hard to make her team, Manchester United, the best they can be. It’s a job that needs lots of thinking and lots of heart. Did you know? Football is the most popular sport in the world! Lots of children, just like you, love to play football in Africa and everywhere else!

Hello, Manchester!

Eva Olid is quite new to Manchester. Manchester is a very big city in a country called England. Imagine a city with lots of tall buildings, big parks, fun shops, and even museums where you can see cool old things! That's Manchester. It's a buzzing place, especially famous for its football teams. When you move to a new place, it can be very exciting, right? There are so many new things to see and do! Eva has been busy working with her team, so she hasn't had much time to look around the city yet. She has been focused on training and games, making sure her team is ready to play. But now, she wants to explore!

Time to Explore!

Eva says she wants to 'discover Manchester'. What does 'discover' mean? It means she wants to find out all the cool and interesting places the city has. She wants to see what's hidden around every corner, just like you might discover a new playground or a special tree in your own neighbourhood. She wants to walk around, look at the buildings, and find out what makes Manchester special. Exploring a new city is like going on a treasure hunt! You never know what amazing things you might find. Maybe a delicious new type of food, or a beautiful park to relax in, or a fun shop with toys. Eva is excited to find out what kind of treasures Manchester holds for her. Did you know? Cities often have special places called landmarks that everyone knows, like big towers or famous statues!

Asking for Ideas!

But how do you find out about all the best places in a new city? Eva has a clever idea! She is 'asking for recommendations'. This means she is asking people who already know Manchester very well for their best ideas. She wants to know: "Where should I go? What should I see? What are the fun things to do here?" It's a smart way to explore! If you wanted to find the best mango stand in your town, you would ask your friends or your parents, wouldn't you? That's what Eva is doing. She is asking people for their favourite spots, so she doesn't miss out on any of the city's wonders. Maybe someone will tell her about a lovely park, or a tasty restaurant, or a cool museum!

A Little Break

When does Eva have time to explore? Right now, it's something called an 'international break'. This is a special time when the players from her team, Manchester United, go away to play for their own countries. Many footballers are from different countries, so sometimes they leave their club team to play for their home country's team. During this international break, Eva still has work to do, but it's a little bit quieter without all the players around. It's the perfect time for her to take a moment and explore her new home city. It's like when school is closed for a holiday, and you have time to do something fun at home or with your family. This is Eva's chance to be a tourist in her own city! Did you know? Many football players speak different languages because they come from all over the world!

Fun Things to Find!

So, what kinds of things might Eva discover in Manchester? Maybe she will find a big park where she can go for a walk and enjoy nature. Or perhaps a museum filled with interesting stories about history or art. She might even try some special food that Manchester is famous for. There could be colourful markets or cool libraries. Imagine Eva walking down a street and seeing something amazing she never knew was there! That's the joy of exploring. She could find a friendly coffee shop, or a place to buy books, or even a theatre where people watch plays. The city is full of surprises, and Eva is ready to find them.

Why Exploring is Great!

Exploring is not just fun, it's also a great way to learn new things. When you explore, you see different sights, hear new sounds, and meet new people. It helps you feel more at home in a new place. For Eva, exploring Manchester will help her understand the city better and feel more connected to where she lives and works. Just like you might explore your own village or town, Eva is exploring her new city. It's wonderful to be curious and open to new adventures. We hope Eva has the most amazing time discovering all the wonderful secrets of Manchester. Maybe she will find her new favourite place to relax after a big football match! Good luck, Eva, and happy exploring!
summary: Eva Olid, the manager of Manchester United football team, is excited to explore her new city, Manchester, during a break from games, and is asking people for fun ideas of where to go and what to see.
whyMatters: This story is important because it shows us that even busy adults like football managers need time to explore and learn about new places, just like kids do, and it's always fun to discover new things in your city.
